Amanda T.: quick idea — run a compact inline estimator on the pricing page (small footprint, CTA tie to webinar) + tighten FAQ accordion copy. low-effort experiment, high signal? Lia Chen: love this. what metric are we optimizing? conversion to webinar signups or trial starts? Amanda T.: primary = trial starts (7-day), secondary = webinar signups. also watch bounce on /pricing. Rob S.: we should do two variants: 1) compact estimator that shows monthly and yearly cost with a subtle savings badge, 2) same estimator but nudge for committed discount (CTA: "See committed savings"). A/B test. Pranav K.: routing note — if estimator output > $5k/mo, tag lead as "enterprise-pkg" and send to SDR queue. can do via existing lead-webhook. Julia M.: copy for micro-FAQ suggestion: "How do you calculate tokens?" -> "Estimate uses sample workload assumptions — adjust sequence length and concurrency for refined numbers." shorter. Amanda T.: +1. also try collapsing some FAQ items into tooltips to reduce perceived page length. Rob S.: how long of an experiment? 2 weeks or until 1k estimator uses? Lia Chen: 1k uses seems fine. need to predefine success: +6% trial-starts or +12 webinar CTR. marketing-bot: deploy snippet ready for staging. embed: ```
``` Pranav K.: sample lead-tagging config (for eng): ```{ "threshold_usd_per_month":5000, "tag":"enterprise-pkg", "webhook":"/hooks/sdr" }``` Julia M.: microcopy variants I'm trying: A) "Estimated monthly cost" B) "Typical monthly spend (estimate)" C) "Starting monthly cost — refine with your settings" Amanda T.: let's run A vs C. C might reduce dropoff. Rob S.: technical ask for eng-runtime: ensure estimator call doesn't add >50ms to page load. lazy-load after hero. Pranav K.: noted — we'll lazy-load after LCP. Lia Chen: checklist for launch: tracking events (estimator_open, estimator_submit, estimator_cta_click), GA tag mapping, experiment flag, email routing rules. Amanda T.: can someone own the experiment doc and runbook? I'll draft initial doc and hand to Lia to own analysis. Lia Chen: I'll own analysis. Amanda, can you add proposed dashboard metrics and funnel? Amanda T.: will do. I'll add conversions by bucket (est output bands), lead tags, and retention snapshot at 14 days. Julia M.: draft micro-FAQ for review in #docs in 24h. marketing-bot: staging deploy scheduled @ 2026-09-12T18:00Z. :rocket: Rob S.: tagging eng-runtime and growth to the thread for FYI. :eyes: Amanda T.: thanks team — will post the experiment doc and the A/B variants by EOD. :thumbsup:
